name: Mondrian Mexico City Condesa
positioning: Art-led design hotel between the Roma and Condesa neighborhoods, set in a building by architect José Luis Benlliure, with an Ara Starck mural in every room
best_for: Design and art lovers who want cultural programming on site
Travelers who want a walkable Condesa base close to Parque México

facts.text: The hotel is located between the Roma and Condesa neighborhoods of Mexico City.
Parque México and Parque España are just steps from the hotel.
The hotel is a five-minute walk from Chilpancingo station.
The hotel is built within a mixed-use building constructed around the mid-century.
The reception area has two swinging benches suspended by heavy rope.
The Skyline Terrace Suite has a private furnished terrace with sweeping Mexico City skyline views.
The Mondrian Terrace Suite has sliding glass doors that open onto a large, fully furnished private terrace.
The Condesa Penthouse has 180-degree views of Condesa from a spacious private terrace.
The hotel's concierge is a Les Clefs d'Or member.
Pasana Spa offers holistic wellness treatments inspired by local traditions.
La Terraza by Mondrian is a patio offering bar snacks and classic cocktails.
The FlowerShop combines a florist, a cafe and a wine bar in one space.

highlights.text: Each room and suite features a signature Ara Starck mural.
The Ara Starck mural in the rooms depicts aqueducts in bold primary and secondary colors, a nod to the history of Mexico City and the neighborhood.
The hotel is set within a building by architect José Luis Benlliure.
The Roma Penthouse has 180-degree views of the Mexico City skyline from a private, fully furnished terrace.
The hotel regularly hosts cultural events including art exhibitions, live music and DJ sets.

considerations.text: The hotel does not currently have a swimming pool.
Rooms are on the smaller side.
Mexico City sits at an altitude of over 2,200 meters, so guests may want to allow time to acclimatize.
